bug_semantics: LiquidJS accepted a lexically resolved template pathname as proof that the file opened was inside a configured root, partials, or layouts directory. Node then followed symlinks at the file operation, so a symlink placed under an allowed template directory could point to an arbitrary readable file outside that directory and include, render, or layout would parse and render the external target. The assigned advisory records liquidjs <= 10.25.2 as vulnerable and 10.25.3 as the first patched version.
flaw_origin: Commit 8fbbec089fa4e3db4bec47462b1c08dd65c36648 is the smallest real BIC. Although the commit also moved existing modules, its newly added index.js handleCache() resolved an include name with path.resolve(this.options.root, filepath) and passed that non-canonical pathname to fs.readFileSync(), while the newly added tags/include.js evaluated the include name and called handleCache(). The immediate parent had neither handleCache/renderFile nor tags/include.js, so the causal filesystem-template load path was absent; later loader extractions, path checks, and file moves merely preserved or re-expressed this same symlink-following flaw.
ai_marker: absent: git cat-file -p 8fbbec089fa4e3db4bec47462b1c08dd65c36648 shows author and committer harttle <yangjvn@126.com>, a 2016 timestamp, and the complete commit message 'tag:include', with no AI tool name, bot identity, Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Made-with, or other AI marker.
evidence: The assigned GHSA-56p5-8mhr-2fph advisory describes the pathname-versus-realpath mismatch, including an allowed-directory symlink that targets a file outside the directory, and gives <= 10.25.2 / 10.25.3 as the vulnerable/patched boundary.

git show 8fbbec089fa4e3db4bec47462b1c08dd65c36648 -- index.js tags/include.js shows the first complete vulnerable path: new renderFile()/handleCache(), path.resolve(root, filepath), fs.readFileSync(filepath), and new include-tag evaluation flowing into handleCache(). git show 21bde3cb6d1096d7c03f5a047683cb3a83f8b4d2:index.js lacks renderFile and handleCache, git ls-tree -r --name-only of that parent has no tags/include.js, and git diff --name-status parent..BIC reports A tags/include.js. Thus the flaw is directly absent from the immediate parent, and the R100 module moves in the BIC are not mistaken for its origin.

The disputed fix claim was primary direct_fix_sha=529dd67eeb6b125637623d6a723601f0938d3613 versus reviewer direct_fix_sha=cca3da6147fbc59a5a78875015295327a9ee59e9 (both audits otherwise named 529dd67eeb6b125637623d6a723601f0938d3613 as fix_sha). git log --reverse abc058be0f33d6372cd2216f4945183167abeb25..origin/fix-fs-contains gives the source sequence cca3da6147fbc59a5a78875015295327a9ee59e9, b181b08543ed69b081c72fc3ba59f6b5159d9fe9, 3538864119abdc7e2b82705950c9f3235c5c2235. git show cca3da6147fbc59a5a78875015295327a9ee59e9 shows the first direct causal edit: async and sync contains canonicalize both root and candidate using realpath/realpathSync, return false on resolution failure, and add outside-root symlink checks. Its parent abc058be0f33d6372cd2216f4945183167abeb25 still performs lexical startsWith containment.

git cat-file -p 529dd67eeb6b125637623d6a723601f0938d3613 shows parent abc058be0f33d6372cd2216f4945183167abeb25 and a squash message containing all three source-branch subjects. git rev-parse 529dd67eeb6b125637623d6a723601f0938d3613^{tree} and 3538864119abdc7e2b82705950c9f3235c5c2235^{tree} both return 1c07d2741651bcf021038890a0e349d28a4cea81, while git diff between them is empty. Therefore 529dd67eeb6b125637623d6a723601f0938d3613 is the landed release-reachable squash fix, not the direct source commit; the reviewer wins the direct_fix_sha disagreement and the primary's aggregate-as-direct claim is rejected.

Version-boundary commands resolve v10.25.2 to 521177e3f63c160c2e093cc4f2b151f51f333f45 and v10.25.3 to 8f69a0839903d85c7b5c9097e39ecce6ac3eab05. git merge-base --is-ancestor reports that 529dd67eeb6b125637623d6a723601f0938d3613 is not in v10.25.2 but is in v10.25.3; git cat-file -p 8f69a0839903d85c7b5c9097e39ecce6ac3eab05 shows 529dd67eeb6b125637623d6a723601f0938d3613 as its immediate parent and the release message names the realpath fix. The source commit cca3da6147fbc59a5a78875015295327a9ee59e9 is not an ancestor of v10.25.3 because GitHub landed its tree through the squash.

reasoning: The causal flaw is the gap between a lexical root-relative pathname and the canonical identity of the file ultimately opened. Tracing the actual input-to-open path, rather than blamed containment code or later moves, reaches 8fbbec089fa4e3db4bec47462b1c08dd65c36648, whose direct parent lacks the entire file-template/include capability. The realpath change closes that mechanism. For the assigned fix_sha topic, both blind audits correctly identified 529dd67eeb6b125637623d6a723601f0938d3613 as the landed fix present at the patched version boundary, but they disagreed on whether it was also the direct fix. Exact source-branch history and identical-tree evidence prove that 529dd67eeb6b125637623d6a723601f0938d3613 is a three-commit squash aggregate; cca3da6147fbc59a5a78875015295327a9ee59e9 is the first source commit that directly replaces lexical containment with realpath containment. Accordingly the reviewer is correct on direct_fix_sha and the primary is wrong to reuse the aggregate there. AI attribution is evaluated only on the BIC commit object, where no marker exists, so the gate-complete verdict is NOT_AI despite Cursor trailers on later fix commits.
